claims.text: The normally specified coolant mixture for the HMMWV (M998-series) engine cooling system is a 50/50 mixture of antifreeze (ethylene glycol) and distilled water.
The 50/50 mixture of antifreeze (ethylene glycol) and distilled water provides optimal cooling performance under normal operating conditions.
The 50/50 mixture of antifreeze (ethylene glycol) and distilled water prevents freezing under normal operating conditions.
The 50/50 mixture of antifreeze (ethylene glycol) and distilled water protects the HMMWV (M998-series) engine from overheating under normal operating conditions.
The coolant mixture information is based on standard maintenance practices for the M998-series HMMWV outlined in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1.
The coolant mixture information is consistent with general U.S. Army vehicle maintenance guidelines.
